android_mechanism: Conversation messages filtered in memory after materialization; fix filters in SQLite
bug_description: Searching local songs materializes the entire songs table via getAllSongs() (already loaded in full by the page) and then filters with Array.filter over songFile strings in memory for every search submission. With a large local library the search does O(total_songs) string work on the UI path instead of an indexed SQLite LIKE query that returns only matching rows.
fix_summary: A getSongsByKeyword query (RdbPredicates.like on songFile, with LIKE-wildcard escaping) performs the filtering in SQLite; the page search handler awaits it directly instead of filtering the full in-memory list.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

evidence.note: 96.8M vs 30.6M instructions (3.2x) even at the small 10-song fixture; the gap grows with library size

mechanism_oracle.definition: Wall time of the case action, measured in the app.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed scans all rows in memory (CPU grows with library size); fixed returns only matching rows from SQLite. With >= 300 local songs, unfixed_avg_ms > fixed_avg_ms.

reproduction: git -C hosts/cloudmusic checkout case/cloudmusic_local_song_memory_filter/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/cloudmusic checkout case/cloudmusic_local_song_memory_filter/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
